title: Java Version Downgrade Persists Despite User Configuration
body:
**Bug Description**
You've downgraded my project from java 23 to jave 17 for the third time today despite me telling claude not to do this and to keep it pinned at 23. clearly a bug.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.90
- Feedback ID: d28b0ebd-7a53-467d-9fd6-f4414f813f6b
